props.name: indeterminate
props.reason: adico extension gap: this is represented as one three-variant enum (e.g. CheckboxState { Checked, Indeterminate, Unchecked }) rather than a separate checked/indeterminate boolean pair -- same capability, a different representation, not planned to change

props.name: form
props.reason: adico extension gap, deferred (not a permanent design choice): native form participation (FormData inclusion, constraint validation) needs a hidden mirror <input> synced to the controlled value, a new adico-primitives mechanism this change's prop-surface scope does not cover; tracked as follow-up primitive work

props.name: nativeButton
props.reason: Dioxus components render a single fixed element type; there is no prop to swap between a native <button> and a generic element

props.name: parent
props.reason: adico extension gap, deferred (not a permanent design choice): Base UI's tri-state parent/child checkbox relationship (a parent automatically becoming indeterminate based on its children's checked states, e.g. a "select all" pattern) has no adico equivalent; needs new primitive-level relationship-tracking work, tracked as follow-up

props.name: uncheckedValue
props.reason: adico extension gap, deferred (not a permanent design choice): native form participation (FormData inclusion, constraint validation) needs a hidden mirror <input> synced to the controlled value, a new adico-primitives mechanism this change's prop-surface scope does not cover; tracked as follow-up primitive work

props.name: inputRef
props.reason: Dioxus uses component-local signals/mounted-node hooks for DOM access, not React ref forwarding

props.name: id
props.reason: adico extension gap: settable via this part's generic `attributes` extends forwarding (spread last, so a caller-supplied value overrides adico's own internal one); no dedicated named prop for a plain global attribute with no additional behavior

props.name: style
props.reason: Dioxus has no inline style-object prop; styling is done via `class`/Tailwind utilities

props.name: render
props.reason: Dioxus has no render-prop/style-object escape hatch to swap the rendered element

props.name: children
props.reason: adico extension gap: this component always renders its own fixed built-in visual (a checkmark, a thumb, a fill bar) with no children slot for the caller to customize it; the shadcn axis doesn't expose this as customizable either, confirming it's a deliberate design choice, not planned to change
